_comment: What is live on the App Store, versus what is being prepared.
This file exists because the three public websites had no way to tell those apart.
CHANGELOG.md's first numbered heading is the release being PREPARED, not the one that
shipped: ci_post_clone.sh reads it to stamp MARKETING_VERSION for the build. Gunzino's
version workflow read that same heading and labelled it 'Shipped version', so on
2026-08-13 gunzino.me advertised 5.0 while App Store Connect download data showed 4.9 as
the newest version any user had. Docs/ai/STATE.md and the RepoOS router made the same
conflation.
Update app_store when a build actually goes live, not when it is submitted.
Update preparing when a new numbered heading is added to CHANGELOG.md.
Both values must match a '## <version>' heading in CHANGELOG.md; the sync workflows fail
loudly if they do not, rather than publishing a guess.
2026-08-27: iOS 5.0 approved. Both platforms are now live at 5.0, so app_store is 5.0 and
the divergence recorded below is resolved. macOS 5.0.1 is still in review; app_store does
not move for it until it is approved. The note below is kept as the record of why the
number sat at 4.9 for a day.
2026-08-26: the two platforms diverged, which this schema cannot express in one number.
macOS 5.0 (build 379) is APPROVED AND LIVE. iOS 5.0 (build 386) is IN REVIEW, so the
newest version an iPhone or iPad user can install is still 4.9. app_store therefore stays
at 4.9 on purpose: it is the value that does not overclaim to an iOS visitor, and
understating is the safe direction for the exact failure this file was created to stop.
The per-platform truth is in app_store_by_platform below, which no workflow reads yet.
leave app_store alone -- iOS is still the constraint.
ACTION WHEN macOS 5.0.1 CLEARS REVIEW: set app_store to 5.0.1 and add a '## 5.0.1' check.
iOS will then be the lagging platform, so do not move it past what iOS actually has.
verified_against: iOS 5.0 (build 386) approved and available for distribution 2026-08-27. macOS 5.0 (build 379) live since 2026-08-26. macOS 5.0.1 (build 387) still in review.
